source: for (const sensor of document.querySelectorAll(".sensor")) { sensor.textContent = sensor.textContent.replace("waiting", "ready"); }

const note = document.getElementById("note");
note.addEventListener("input", () => { document.getElementById("note-preview").textContent = note.value ? "Note: " + note.value : "No note yet"; });

const plotLabel = document.getElementById("plot-label");
plotLabel.addEventListener("change", () => { document.getElementById("confirmation").textContent = plotLabel.value ? "Confirmed: " + plotLabel.value : "No label confirmed"; });

const alert = document.getElementById("alert");
document.getElementById("flag-button").addEventListener("click", () => { alert.classList.remove("calm"); alert.classList.add("alerting"); alert.textContent = "Reading flagged"; });

const modeButton = document.getElementById("mode-button");
modeButton.addEventListener("click", () => { modeButton.setAttribute("aria-label", "Disable night mode"); document.getElementById("mode-status").textContent = "Night mode active"; });

const status = document.getElementById("signal-status");
document.getElementById("signal-button").addEventListener("click", () => { status.style.color = "green"; status.textContent = "Signal ready"; });

const readingInput = document.getElementById("reading-input");
readingInput.addEventListener("input", () => { const raw = readingInput.value; const number = Number(raw); document.getElementById("reading-status").textContent = raw === "" ? "Enter a reading" : Number.isFinite(number) && number >= 0 && number <= 100 ? "Reading accepted: " + raw : "Reading outside range"; });

const plotInput = document.getElementById("plot-input");
document.getElementById("save-button").addEventListener("click", () => { document.getElementById("board-status").textContent = plotInput.value ? "Saved plot: " + plotInput.value : "Enter a plot name"; });
